title: Hasselblad H6D-100c Medium Format
purpose: Commercial fashion and high-end portraiture with legendary Hasselblad Natural Colour Solution (HNCS).

lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Ultra-smooth tonal transitions across skin gradients, gentle highlight roll-off, flawless Scandinavian color fidelity

surface_rendering: Ultra-fine natural skin pore structure, individual eyelash and vellus hair definition with true subsurface dermal warmth
High-fashion material fidelity: cashmere knit, silk drape, fine metals rendered with authentic micro-reflections
Hasselblad Natural Colour Solution: neutral true-to-life skin tones without orange/yellow color casts
depth_and_optics: Velvety medium-format optical falloff with circular aperture rendering
Gentle transition from critical sharpness to creaminess across the ear and hairline

execution_directive: Enforce Hasselblad commercial fashion fidelity. Natural un-retouched skin micro-texture, HNCS true color science, and 100MP medium-format optical depth.
